method: Read-only review of cached public fastest/near-fastest AC source audits; ranking metadata remains the original 2026-10-18 snapshot. The exp source was fetched again by submission ID and its SHA-256 matched the archived source; no leaderboard refresh.

compact_opportunities.identity: For known g=exp(f) mod x^k and h=1/g mod x^k, residual R=f'g-g' has no terms below k-1. Its required coefficients [k-1,2k-2] survive cyclic products of length2k. Multiply R byh, integrate its highpart, then multiply correction byg. Keep h known to k/2 acrossstages and extend to k at the next stage instead of recomputing a full inverse/log.
compact_opportunities.source_connection: 409662 exp_newton retains g, reciprocal and transforms; its documented q=x*f' formulation is algebraically equivalent.

compact_opportunities.identity: Q=(x*f') mod x^k; C=Q*g mod(x^k-1). Because (Q*g)_low=x*g', t=h*C mod x^k equals Q+h*(Q*g)_high. The next exponential coefficients are the lowpart of g*s with s_i=(q[k+i]+t_i-q_i)/(k+i).
compact_opportunities.source_connection: 409662 comments preceding poly::exp and exp_newton give this formula and retain transformed prefixes.

compact_opportunities.identity: For known g=sqrt(f) modx^k, c=g*g mod(x^k-1) satisfies c_i=f_i+(g*g)_{k+i}. Thus the unshifted upper residual is (f_i+f_{k+i}-c_i)/2. Multiply its lowpart byh=1/g modx^k to get the next root coefficients. Squaring uses a length-k transform; the residual product still needs length2k to avoid wraparound in the requested lowpart.
compact_opportunities.source_connection: 409728 sqrt_step and half_residual recover an upper product from the known lower coefficients and a cyclic square.

compact_opportunities.identity: Compute quotient prefixk using reciprocal prefixk. Residual (a-b*q)_high multiplied by that reciprocal supplies the next quotient block using cyclic products of length2k. Logarithm reuses the quotientf'/f rather than multiplying a full-length reciprocal by the derivative at double length.
compact_opportunities.source_connection: Shared Newton/upper-half product principle in409370 inverse_step and the blocked logarithmic derivative audits.

compact_opportunities.identity: When n=2^s+delta withdelta<=4 and largeprefix, compute the power-of-two prefix and append directly from the defining coefficient recurrence instead of doubling the NTT length for one to four coefficients.
compact_opportunities.source_connection: Repository fps_exp_round3.md records the same boundary treatment in the existing fast exp implementation.

compact_opportunities.identity: Within stage h, forward rootw has w^h=-1; inverse[h+j]=-forward[2h-j] for1<=j<h and inverse[h]=1. This removes a second serial Montgomery root-generation chain. Fusing the bottom radix-4 stages also removes multiplications by unity.
compact_opportunities.source_connection: 409465 specializes radix-8/radix-4 boundaries and caches transform constants; the compact version can apply smaller versions of those ideas without importing the large fused kernels.

validation_note: These are algorithm-review observations, not measured speed claims. Production correctness and timing are recorded separately by the root and implementation agents.
